props.heading: what a model cannot hold
props.body: The relationship that makes a student push past the first wrong answer. The read of the room. The judgment of what THIS student needs today. None of this is held in the model.

props.heading: the friction law
props.body: Remove extraneous cognitive load (unclear instructions, formatting noise) — good. Protect germane difficulty (the confusion before the insight, the effort that builds the schema) — never remove it.

props.heading: the engagement trap
props.body: Products optimized for engagement maximize time-on-app. But if the goal is durable learning, the metric is wrong. Loved products that don't teach are still failures. The measure is Tier 4 capability, not completion rate.
